audience: US and Indian investors; primary focus United States
_provider_help: gemini = Google AI Studio free tier (GEMINI_API_KEY). anthropic = Claude (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, paid).
_model_help: Ordered fallback list. gemini-3.6-flash (best) has a low free-tier daily cap; the -lite models have far higher limits and take over on 429/503. Anthropic provider: use claude-haiku-4-5.
_mode_help: publish = auto-publish. pending = send everything to the review queue instead (recommended for the first few days).
_indexNowKey_help: Also set this exact value in Rank Math -> Instant Indexing -> IndexNow, and in plugins/moneypuran-news-seo (MP_INDEXNOW_KEY). The plugin serves it at /<key>.txt.
_cap_help: perRunCap per scheduled run; dailyCap is the real ceiling. Keep dailyCap credible for a small newsroom. Source order below is priority order — marketwrap is first so the daily recaps never get starved by a full feed.

sebi._note: SEBI has no press-release RSS; only an enforcement-order feed. Leave off until a better feed is wired in.

_authors_help: Create real editor accounts in WordPress (Users -> Add New, role Author) and map categories to their IDs below for E-E-A-T bylines.
